description: Rural Hotel, Andalusia. Cortijo 600m2 with Swimming pool and lovely views. Professional kitchen. Pretty gardens with a variety of flowers & shrubs including roses, vines, bougainvillea. A 2 bedroom, private country house with a swimming-pool next to the Hotel could be included under negotiation, or rented . description: The hotel resort is designed on a plot of 8,620sqm, qualified as tertiary land for commercial and hotel use. The preliminary project covers the conversion of the existing shopping center. title: Rural Hotel Between Mountains And 25 Minutes From The Beach
description: A rural hotel with restaurant in a landscape environment where you can be in touch with nature, for lovers of the sea and the mountains. There is a common living room with fireplace, reception, and restaurant with 2 halls (one for more formal events and the other with a bar).
